text:
- **Site access control:** The pm service now checks Cloudflare Access tokens. It refuses requests that lack a valid token. The check accepts only app-type tokens, so a public login token is refused. The site also flags a main checkout that is behind its remote.
- **Public website and README:** A marketing website for pm is live on GitHub Pages. The README now presents pm as a human-agent project management suite. Each claim in it was checked against the code. Today summaries now tell only what happened, with no to-do for the owner.
- **Test and CI speed:** CI now shards Go tests by measured durations and trims the caches it saves. CI now blocks code that fails golangci-lint, deadcode or ruff. The test suite now keeps only tests with unique value. More than half of the non-live tests were removed, and all bug guards were kept.
- **Codex integration:** The owner-request hook now reads the root session id, not the subagent thread id. A gap list compares pm with Claude Code. Each gap in the list is closed on a branch or kept by a project decision. The owner answered whether pm init should mark its Codex hooks as trusted.
